$comment: Scoop manifest for the doctiling bucket. Publish: copy into the doctiling/scoop-bucket repo as bucket/doctiling.json. checkver/autoupdate keep url+hash current per release.
description: Editorial studio for documents and the AI agents that read them — self-hosted
notes: First run generated %USERPROFILE%\.doctiling\.env with every secret (local AI defaults).
The 'Doctiling' logon task starts the app at http://127.0.0.1:3000 — install it as an app from your browser.
Local AI needs LM Studio or Ollama serving http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1 (edit LLM_BASE_URL in .env for a different port).
